groups.canonical_name: High leverage and debt service burden
groups.definition: Significant outstanding debt requires cash for debt service, may force refinancing or asset sales, and restricts financial and strategic flexibility.

groups.canonical_name: Competitive pricing pressure from Asian rivals
groups.definition: Emerging competitors, including state-supported Chinese semiconductor firms, may erode prices and market share.

groups.canonical_name: Fixed cost operating leverage in manufacturing
groups.definition: Owning manufacturing capacity creates high fixed costs that compress margins when utilization or volume falls.
Cyclical and macro-driven swings in end-market demand, including industry overcapacity, cause revenue and profitability volatility.

groups.canonical_name: Automotive overcapacity and incentive pricing pressure
groups.definition: Industry overcapacity and competitors' subsidized incentives force matching price concessions, eroding margins given fixed labor costs.
